travelyourearth.configuration.title: Travel Your Earth Configuration
travelyourearth.configuration.showCreati: Shows the "Travel Your Earth" Mod Tab with every item from the mod. The items still appear in the vanilla tabs too. If you change it with a world open, leave and join again to see it.
travelyourearth.configuration.menuEffect: Animations of the mod's config menu: the floating logo, the beating splash text and the surprise when you click "Made with ❤". Turn it off for a still menu.
travelyourearth.configuration.enhancedBe: Materials panel with a search box (the book button) and the payment items rotating at the bottom. Turn it off for the vanilla beacon screen.
travelyourearth.configuration.darkIllega: Illegal trades (and the wandering smuggler's ruby trades) are drawn with a dark button. Turn it off to see them like normal trades.
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalRai: Shows "Illegal deal: it can start a raid" when you hover an illegal trade. If you don't have enough XP, the level requirement is always shown.
travelyourearth.configuration.modAdvance: Moves the mod's advancements from the "Adventure" tab to their own Mod Tab. The tab appears after getting your first Ruby. If you change it with a world open, leave and join again.
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalRes: Ticks an illegal villager needs to restock its illegal trades. 1 day = 24000 ticks. Default: 72000 (3 days).
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalSca: Ticks an illegal villager runs away from villagers and iron golems after being seen trading. Default: 1200 (1 minute).
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalWan: Ticks an illegal villager is wanted after someone rings the bell on it. Catch it with a boat before it escapes! Default: 6000 (5 minutes).
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalAvo: Ticks the other illegal villagers avoid you after you snitch on one with a bell. The snitched villager avoids you forever. Default: 6000 (5 minutes).
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalNig: Smugglers go out 1 night of every this many days (all on the same night). Default: 3.
travelyourearth.configuration.illegalShu: Ticks the other villagers don't talk to an illegal villager after it's seen trading. Default: 24000 (1 day).
Ticks the other villagers don't talk to an illegal villager after someone snitches on it with a bell. Default: 72000 (3 days).
Ticks the other villagers don't talk to an illegal villager after it's caught in a boat. Default: 168000 (7 days).
